{{Quote|The Science Bureau wants them for research. Moff Ghorrin wants them for a special strike team. Whatever's left of their lives won't be pretty.|Sarnova|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Ghorrin''' was a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. When [[Grathan]]'s experiments with the [[OHK-99]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] was discovered, Ghorrin wanted the units to use as a strike team.
